{{Top|leg}}
An '''incinerator''' was a weapon capable of incinerating any living thing. The [[incinerator rifle]] was commonly used by [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan spies]] who used their stealth ability to get as close to an enemy as possible and incinerate them. Its chassis was similar in appearance to that of a [[CR-1 blaster cannon/Legends|CR-1 blaster cannon]].
